name: Grok for Outlook
desc: Outlook add-in that summarizes threads, drafts replies and tidies the inbox.
desc_zh: Outlook 加载项，总结长邮件串、用你的语气起草回复并整理收件箱。
solves: Catching up on a thread means reading forty messages; the add-in reads them and hands you a reply that sounds like you.
solves_zh: 追一个邮件串要读四十封；加载项替你读完，再给你一封语气像你写的回复。
best_for: You return from leave to hundreds of unread messages and need to answer the ones that matter.
best_for_zh: 休假回来堆着几百封未读，只需要回那些真正重要的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory; channel A Microsoft Marketplace listing）。 Last of the four Grok Office add-ins. The marketplace URL redirects by dropping the locale segment. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对同类功能的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-outlook-addin 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/WA200011330?tab=Overview）。
